items.title: How much signifier does a hidden gesture actually need?
items.description: Illustrative model, not a measured study: represents L3's task-row redesign. As you add signifier strength (0 = the original bare row with no icon or hint, higher = a dimmer hint, then a visible outline, then a fully filled icon), first-time discovery climbs fast at first, then levels off — while the row's visual quietness (how 'clean' the minimal design still looks) drops the more the row insists on announcing itself. Drag the slider to see where a small signifier already buys most of the discovery gain, without spending all the way to a loud, cluttered row.

params.name: signifierStrength
params.label: Signifier strength added to the row

items.compute: const firstTimeDiscoveryPercent = Math.min(96, Math.round(12 + 78 * (1 - Math.exp(-params.signifierStrength * 0.85)))); const visualQuietnessScore = Math.round((10 - params.signifierStrength * 1.8) * 10) / 10; return { firstTimeDiscoveryPercent, visualQuietnessScore };

outputs.label: First-time users who discover the action
Row's visual quietness (10 = original bare row)
